searched: docs/work/pinned-deps-update-path/job-1.diff in full (the round-2 change: 143 lines, tui/go.sum only)

findings.summary: F-1-1 stays open. The round-2 diff touches only tui/go.sum, so `go 1.26.0` in tui/go.mod is unchanged. Nothing in the diff, the work order or the journal acknowledges the bump from 1.24.6, or shows that the gitleaks module requires 1.26. CI reads `go-version-file: tui/go.mod`, so the toolchain change reaches every build.

F-1-2 stays open. The round-2 diff removes the old hashes for x/net 0.43.0, x/sync 0.16.0, x/sys 0.35.0 and x/text 0.28.0, which confirms the shipped TUI dependencies now resolve to x/net 0.53.0, x/sync 0.20.0, x/sys 0.43.0 and x/text 0.36.0. The work order's claim that none of the new requires link into the TUI binary is still uncorrected. No record accepts the dependency change as a side effect, and no check beyond `tests(tui)` covers it.

F-1-3 stays open. The round-2 change adds no test and no check for SC-1, and the new `verified` records list the same covered checks as round 1, none of which invokes `go tool`. The only change is a go.sum tidy: it adds missing hashes for go-spew, quicktest, go-cmp, kr/pretty, testify and others, and drops the stale hashes for x/exp 2022 and 2023, x/net, x/sync, x/sys and x/text. That cleanup is consistent with `go mod tidy` and does not answer any of the three findings. Its correctness, including whether the added hashes are right, was not checked.
